items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: Him and Dill stayed in the same business. After that Dill moved on another floor.

ctx.x: How long you had that picture? Oh, just a few weeks. Yeah. I got it from a friend of mine. He's dead now, I think.
Oh, yeah. He's on the ground. I was hanging around on a 29th wall back with Big Mason's back. It was a bad left hand, man. It was a bad left hand you want to see.
